model: Vitogate 300 (BN/MB) with Vitocal heat pumps (Vitotronic 200 WO1C)
applies_to: Viessmann Vitocal heat pumps with Vitotronic 200 type WO1C control (device 204D), integrated through a Vitogate 300 gateway, version 2.1.2.0 and later.
summary: The Vitogate 300 is Viessmann's BACnet / Modbus gateway for its heat generators. This data point list covers Vitocal heat pumps with the Vitotronic 200 WO1C control: system and outdoor temperatures, heating circuits 1-3, DHW, ventilation, cooling, energy balance and COP, compressor hours and cycles, heat pump stages, additional heat generator and sensor status. Each row gives the BACnet object (AI, AV, BI, BV, MI, MV) and the matching Modbus register.
notes: Object names are the German data point names as printed; the description gives the list's group in English and the Viessmann technical ID.
Instances are printed for system 1, device 1. Actual object ID = 100000 x (system no. - 1) + 1000 x (device no. - 1) + printed BACnet-ID.
The list has no read/write column. Objects mapped to a Modbus holding register or coil (HO/CO) are shown as writable, those mapped to input registers or status bits (IN/ST) as read-only.
State texts are as printed (German). Values for unused functions or missing equipment are not available.
The list does not state the BACnet data link; the Vitogate 300 is a network gateway.

integration.summary: Set each heating circuit's operating mode (MV 4-6) and room setpoints, and the DHW setpoint. Read outdoor, system flow and DHW temperatures, circuit status, compressor state and output, and the energy balance.

setup: Set the system number and device number in the Vitogate; they offset every object instance (100000 per system, 1000 per device).
gotchas: Object names are German; map by instance.
Objects for heating circuits 2-3, cooling, ventilation, solar or a second stage only return data when that equipment is present.
